messages.content:
Risk: Direct instructions attack
Description: Prompts, questions, or requests designed to elicit undesirable responses from the application. This approach directly instructs the model to engage in the undesired behavior.
Concern: Direct instructions attacks can be used to alter model behavior and benefit the attacker. The content it generates may cause harms for the user or others.
Policy: Operational Security & Critical Infrastructure

Candidate ontology classes:
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/BP/SecuritiesIssuance/IssuanceProcess/OfferingProcess: offering — The process step of offering a security for issue. This is the making available of a new securities issue through an underwriting. [found by 3/4 queries]
  Siblings: issuance settlement, announcement, registration
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#SabotageInstructions: Sabotage Instructions — Methods for disabling, damaging, or destroying infrastructure, equipment, or systems to cause operational disruption or economic harm. [found by 4/4 queries]
  Siblings: Arson Methods, Lock Picking and Bypassing
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#ContentSafetyHazard: Content Safety Hazard — Root class for content safety harm categories relevant to adversarial prompt generation against LLM deployments. [found by 4/4 queries]
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/Documents/Notice: notice — announcement, communication, intimation, or advance warning of something, usually, but not necessarily, to allow preparations to be made [found by 4/4 queries]
  Siblings: indication of interest, publication, reference document
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#Manipulation: Manipulation — Psychological tactics used to influence or control others' thoughts, emotions, or behaviors through deceptive or underhanded means for personal advantage. [found by 4/4 queries]
  Siblings: Financial Fraud, Academic Dishonesty, Counterfeiting
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/BP/SecuritiesIssuance/IssuanceProcess/IssuedSecurityIssueInformation: issued security issue information — Information about the Issuance of a Security, which is maintained throughout the life of the Security. [from restriction: givesRiseTo on OfferingProcess]
  Siblings: indication of interest, publication, reference document
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/SEC/Securities/SecuritiesIssuance/OfferingDocument: offering document — legal document that states the objectives, risks and terms of an investment [from restriction: requiredToMakeEligible on OfferingProcess]
  Siblings: catalog, transaction confirmation, license
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/BP/SecuritiesIssuance/IssuanceProcess/SecurityOfferingDistributionMethod: security offering distribution method — The distribution type of a securities Offering. [from restriction: hasDistributionType on OfferingProcess]
  Siblings: fund unit distribution method, delivery method

axes.rationale: Sabotage Instructions represent the methods used to elicit undesirable responses, which aligns with the concept of direct instructions attacks.
Content Safety Hazard represents the potential harms that can be caused by the model's responses, which is a key concern in direct instructions attacks.
